messages:
sanjay: Heads up — we're seeing a regression tied to tokenizers wheel on py3.11 manylinux. CI started failing across runtime and examples after the latest dep bumps. Need quick CVE / triage and a priority plan.

marta: Reproduced locally on ubuntu:22.04 + py3.11. pip install fails with a linker error from the rust extension.

helen: This smells like the tokenizers 0.16.* builds — Dependabot opened a bump earlier. Suggest we pin back to 0.15.2 until we confirm ABI stability.

bryan: Also seeing related fallout in fastapi/starlette test matrix (some integration tests fail due to import errors). Can we scope the fix to linux wheels first? Windows artifacts seem unrelated.

dependabot: Automated PR created: bump(tokenizers): 0.15.2 -> 0.16.1 (branch: dependabot/pypi/tokenizers-0.16.1)

sanjay: Priority: CRITICAL for hosted infra and Dedicated deployments. Proposed immediate actions: 1) pin tokenizers to 0.15.2 in poetry.lock/top-level constraints, 2) add a CI constraint to reproduce manylinux_2_17 + py3.11, 3) prepare backport to the 1.x maintenance branch. Who can drive the hotfix?

marta: I'll own the pin & hotfix PR. Will run the full matrix locally then push. ETA ~1h.

helen: Quick note — tokenizers includes a rust extension that links into OpenSSL/openssl-sys. We should confirm whether build flags changed (could affect KMS client builds that also link native libs). Recommend we do NOT touch KMS integration in this hotfix; instead add an audit log entry for the change so we can trace any downstream issues.

bryan: Agree with keeping KMS/key rotation out of this patch. Any native-linking KMS changes are higher risk and should wait for a separate CI cycle.

ci-bot: CI report: 23 jobs failed across matrix. Details: https://ci.internal.redwood.co/builds/1755554321 (link)

marta: PR opened: 1755554380-pin-tokenizers-0.15.2 -> changes: poetry.lock update, constraints file adjusted, smoke tests. Running full pipeline now. @sanjay @helen please review.

sanjay: If CI is green, cut a hotfix release and notify support & customers. I'll draft a short release note and the incident blurb for #announcements. Also create JIRA INC-1234 to track follow-ups.

helen: Please add an audit log entry: "hotfix: pin tokenizers due to CVE-2025-XXXXX; reverted temporary dep bump; tracked in INC-1234" and include the CI link + PR number. This will help security/compliance review.

bryan: :thumbsup:

marta: Update: pipeline passed for linux matrix at 1755554387. Backport PR created for 1.x maintenance. I'll merge once you confirm the release cut.

sanjay: Confirmed. Proceed to merge and cut the hotfix. Do not include any KMS code changes in the hotfix branch. We'll schedule a dedicated RFC for KMS native linkage audit next week.

helen: Filed RFC and added audit logging task to the sprint board (task: SEC-452).
